assessments.name: Final Exam
assessments.description: Exam to test achievement of unit learning outcomes, with a hurdle section that students must achieve a certain score on to pass the unit of study.

assessments.name: EFT: AI to Accelerate Learning
assessments.description: Submit the AI conversation transcript for an interaction to learn about a topic covered in lectures to date.

assessments.name: Presenting technical topic to a small group
assessments.description: Each student is tasked to find out about a relevant technical topic and explain it to their team. AI is allowed for the research, but the in-class component is a presentation and AI cannot be used.
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test

assessments.name: AI for Learning Part 2
assessments.description: Submit an AI conversation transcript for an interaction to learn about a topic relevant to the group project. Students will have to explain that topic to the rest of the team verbally in class.

assessments.name: Project Proposal
assessments.description: Description of project justification, workplan, objectives and deliverables. Individualised marks will be moderated by SPARKPLUS peer evaluation.

assessments.name: Project Final Report
assessments.description: Final project report. Requirements will be discussed in class. Individual marks will be derived from the group mark and moderated by SPARKPLUS assessment.

assessments.name: Q&A on Project
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement

assessments.name: Tutorial attendance
assessments.description: Students must attend at least 80% of all tutorials. Attendance is only recorded if a student stays for at least three-quarters of the duration of the class.
